419882.overview:
Hack: Le Avventure di Mario 1
Created by: Silver/Wakana
Release Date: 2011
Exits: 91
Fixed by: SimFan96

This is the fixed version of Le Avventure di Mario 1 by Wakana. This version fixes the latest released version of the hack including broken music and other issues, in addition to this I also included the original Italian translation of the hack.

Fixes provided:
* Fixed broken music included in the game originally which would crash on console and accurate emulators.
* The hack uses fastrom, however the majority of long addresses didn't use fastrom addressing. This has been fixed and will further reduce slowdown in the hack.
* L+R scrolling in levels with the SMB scroll sprite will no longer softlock the game.
* There will no longer be a small flash of color before the Nintendo Presents screen or on level load.
* There's quite a few areas in the hack that can softlock the player where they can't progress through a level until the timer runs out or the player dies, these have been fixed to prevent this from occuring.
* On accurate emulators, if a level has both HDMA and a large amount of dynamic sprites on the screen, the HDMA gradient will start to flicker random colors. This has been fixed by implementing Ice Man's HDMA 3.5 patch.
* Graphical glitches with some Dynamic sprites have been fixed.
* Code that implements multiplication and division registers have been updated to work correctly in accurate emulators.
* Fixed an issue with the pause routine. Originally, if the player paused the game, the music wouldn't mute, but upon unpausing the music would be muted.
* The lightning generator and level ending question mark orb in Wastelands 4 can be rather glitchy. Commonly, if the player touched the level ending question mark orb at the end of this level, layer 3 elements such as the status bar, message box, or overworld border would be permanently glitched until the player resets the game. This issue has been fixed so layer 3 will no longer glitch from completing this level.
* HDMA gradients will no longer appear on the level transition or game over screens.
* The Yoshi's Island Balloon sprites that appear in Castle 7 can be glitchy if they are placed on the beginning or end of a horizontal screen boundary and can cause the player to be randomly teleported. Touching the sprite will no longer randomly teleport the player.
* In the Enchanted Forest cave level, the HDMA wave effect will not appear after passing the midway point, now it will show even upon returning to the level after collecting the midway point.

Known issues:
* Slowdown is still present in the hack.
* Some graphical glitches still appear.

Notes:
* Music was reinserted using AddMusicKFF.
* SFX Echo re-added to levels and other fixes implemented using UberASM patch.
* This hack fix was tested with both the latest version of BSNES and Snes9x 1.60.

If you find any other issues with this fixed version of the hack don't hesitate to message me on SMWCentral or Talkhaus.

419883.overview: So, in this hack you will find that the Mario’s world is invaded by evils from other games: you will fight against Dr.Eggman, Snake men from Megaman and others! Will our hero restore peace in the world? And the most important question: WHO did all this?

420769.overview: The purpose of this hack was to take the same approach Nintendo took with Ocarina of Time: Master Quest. Numerous Zelda games have a second quest in one form or another, and the author felt that A Link to the Past deserved a similar treatment. The dungeons have detours, rearranged items, tougher enemies, and an intermediate difficulty level. However, an optional “Double Heart Damage” patch is included for those looking for a greater challenge.

421140.overview:
Parallel Remodel is a remodeled version of the famous Zelda3 hack Parallel Worlds, that we all know as an extremely difficult game. Parallel Worlds is altogether a great technological marvel, with new gfx, various asm patches, completely new overworld and dungeons etc. It has the potential of being even better than Alttp, but the gameplay is somewhat too radical. The backtracking was (in not so rare occasions) escalated to the extreme, the same goes for the health of some enemies. Some intellectual problems in the dark world dungeons are algorithm marvels: sure this is a good thing for math (Euclid really fits his nickname), but this is not a good thing for the player, who can easily give up.

Thus the idea of a remodel was born and was approved by SePH. Parallel Remodel therefore brings the difficulty to normal: backtracking was reduced almost to zero, algorithm problems were replaced, various semi bosses were reduced, special stunts like bomb jumping etc were removed, dark rooms are now lit etc.

Parallel Remodel is a game that’s fair to the player and doesn’t want to force any super tricks, stunts or logic to finish the game, while still having a decent difficulty. It makes Parallel Worlds enjoyable. You don’t have to use save states or cheats to finish the game. You don’t have to be a veteran or a super player either. You will not be frustrated while playing.

Parallel Remodel recreates Parallel Worlds according to the 6 years of revisions from players all over the globe. It is suitable for beginners and veterans, for those who have failed at Parallel Worlds and for those who have finished it, since this game is a lot more than just a plain reduction of sprites.

421450.overview:
This is an exceptional remake of all 52 levels of Super Mario Bros. The Lost Levels, in the Super Mario World engine, with Super Mario All-Stars (SMB3) graphics and music. After World 8 you can also revisit old levels with Caped Mario and Yoshi.

Originally released in 2005 under the name Super Mario Bros. The Lost Levels Deluxe, it’s limited by the technology of its time – custom sprites and other modern advances were not yet available. It was later updated in 2012 just to fix some compatibility issues and change its name to Super Mario Bros. The Lost Levels Enhanced, with little to no change in gameplay.

440070.overview:
A complete graphical improvement of Paladin’s Quest! Most palettes have been changed to give it a better presentation. A lot of sprites have also been modified to match their original art. Here’s a sumary of the modifications:

* The weird yellow grass is now green, looking more pleasing.
* Background battle palettes also match the changes: less yellow, more green.
* All cave palettes have been changed accordingly to their battle palettes: they now look darker and more realistic.
* All palettes from the playable characters have been changed! They now match their portraits and/or original art.
* The portraits’ palettes of Chezni and Fiery have been changed to match their sprites.
* Most sprites have been edited to match their original ideas.
* An original sprite for Destry and his lubott-likes have been created, since his old sprite looked nothing like him.
* Spirits abbreviations are now gone! They are now simple and intuitive icons. Spirits window’s palette have also been modified.
* The messed sprites of the enemies ZMaster and Specter are now fixed. Also, the enemies Beholder, Deatheye and * * * * Flamer now have green skin, giving them more emphasis.
* The Raigan timeship is now properly colored, matching its original art. The Underground Tunnel vehicles have also been recolored.
* Many other small graphical improvements: the mountains look better (the grass pixels have been cleaned), Saskuots trees are fixed (they were missing an important outline), Raigan statues from Jurayn are fixed (they shared opposite palettes), and so on!

448384.overview: A fan-made port of The Legend of Zelda from the NES to SNES, by ROM hacker infidelity. Includes a full MSU-1 soundtrack. The game stays true to the original, but with no sprite flicker and slowdown, regardless of how many enemies are running around.  There is also smooth scrolling between screens, in both horizontal and vertical directions.

451201.overview:
This is a sequel of Luigi's Misadventures 3.
It's about the Galactic Kids Next Door.

PLOT:
Previosly in Luigi's Misadventures 3, Luigi saved Numbuh 9000 from Merla and traveled to South Nahow City to retrieve the five determination disks from Professor E.Gadd.
Numbuh 9000 explains that these disks are used to seal the most dangerous creations used by Galactic Kids Next Door. Luigi only has five chances to seal them.
Luigi, Rike and Numbuh 9000 departed to the outer space to search the whereabouts of the Galactic Kids Next Door. However, they ended in the Zero Space Station for refueling.
Luigi must stop the Galactic Kids Next Door in his own.

451202.overview:
PREVIOUSLY IN LUIGI'S MISADVENTURES 4:
Luigi defeated the Galactic Kids Next Door and its supreme leader Numbuh 1 and bring peace to the universe.
Luigi and Rike returned to their world, but their spaceship was ambushed by bullet killers. Luigi and Rike tried to escape, but their spaceship was hit and crashed in Megaville.
Luigi and Rike survived but their spaceship was severely damaged. They discovered that Megaville is being attacked by the same robots used by Merla. But how? And why?
Luigi needs to find where these robots came from and who is the mastermind behind the city siege.

451238.overview:
In the Mushroom Kingdom's war on crime, the worst criminal offenders are perused by the detectives of the Major Case Squad. These are their stories. DUN DUN!

In the Sebastian "Tails" Prower residence, Maurice "Sonic" Hedgehog comes in after a long day when suddenly tragedy strikes. Soon after, the Mushroom Kingdom Unit begins a brand new investigation.

This ROM Hack is a crossover between Law & Order: Special Victims Unit and the familiar Mario cast. You control Elliot Mario, solving cases alongside your partner Olivia Peach, working together with Odafin Yoshi and John Luigi.

This version of the hack is a Director's Cut of the pilot that was entered in the 2023 Questionable Level Design Contest. The original version can be found here if you are curious. Some areas have been expanded on, new places are explorable, and there has been a lot of polishing done to make this the "Definitive Edition."

WARNING: Due to language, mild suggestive themes, smoking, drug/alcohol references, simulated gambling, and a violent reference this may not be suitable for children under the age of 13; player's discretion is advised.

https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=section&a=details&id=38323

452670.overview:
Based off of Frue Lufia, Spekkio Lufia is a battle rebalancing mod that aims to supply more of a challenge while lessening problems in the retail release’s game design. Not only are bosses rebalanced, but certain regular enemies are too. The Ancient Cave also received some tweaks. Enemies of later floors drop more useful rewards, you can buy Blue Chest items in Gift Mode—which is available from the first time you launch the game—and Iris Treasures appear more frequently.

The important updated bosses are as follows.

1. The Sinistrals in the Fortress of Doom are stronger, more befitting final bosses. Also starting with the Revenge Ghost the late game bosses are generally revamped. (In case you have some trouble towards the end, how about talking to some of the more important NPCs all over the world?)

2. The Master can fully heal himself every round. How can you possibly bring him down? There must be some way…

3. The Egg Dragon, who named the patch. He now behaves like Spekkio in Chrono Trigger, his battle script changing based on the highest-leveled party member.

4. La Puella, the beloved pet giant tarantula of the Princess of Parcelyte. She can be fought anytime after defeating Gades in the Ancient Tower. Do you stand a chance against La Puella and all of her fuzzy friends?

Check the Notable_Changes_Spekkio text file for detailed changes. To aid your survival, included are a bestiary, and a list of equipment that provides protection against status ailments.

452676.overview:
This mod offers censorship removal, feature restoration from the NTSC-J release, and gameplay enhancements. Based on Lufia: Decensored by D, which restores alcohol references, priests, and bunny girls. (Terms from Decensored that do not conform to the standards of Lufia games in English, such as Fu-Lay and Erin, have been reverted, e.g. Spark and Erim, etc.)

Features:

• Incorporated Fast Walker by JCE3000GT, with tweaks by rainponcho and Justin3009.
• Incorporated Encounter Rate Fix (50%) by Ok Impala!.
• Restored crosses to church walls.
• Final boss now uses its battle script from the Japanese original.
• Lufia and Selan can equip Jerin and Artea’s Zircon equipment, plus the Might Shield and Might Helmet.
• Rock Golems can drop Might Shields.
• Item descriptions restored.
• Text printing noise now plays when enabling “Fast” Message Speed.
• For series consistency: names of characters, terms, spells, and items conform to the standards of Frue Lufia by Artemis.
• Addendum patch: Unlock Try Again Mode without needing to beat the game.
• Audio defaults to Stereo when starting a new game.

456872.overview: This romhack adds 3-player-coop to Lost Vikings 2.

457572.overview:
The Lost Vikings is a puzzle-platformer game for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System, where the player(s) control three medieval vikings who’ve been abducted and find themselves aboard an alien spaceship. Each state requires teamwork and problem-solving as each of the three vikings has different abilities: Erik the Swift can run, jump, and bash walls or enemies with his head; Baleog the Fierce wields a sword and a bow; while Olaf the Stout carries a large, indestructible shield that can also be used as a platform for Erik to jump from, or as a glider to allow Olaf to drop safely from great heights. Also important is that all three vikings must reach the exit to each level. If one dies, the player can continue the stage but not complete it and has to restart to be able to finish.

This hack was produced by Ragnarok. It incorporates the Sega Genesis port’s extra levels and three-player support in the SNES version’s superior graphics and audio.

458512.overview:
This is a 1:1 port of the NES version of Life Force, running on the SNES. It is utilizing FastROM/HiROM.

NES style music is provided via Memblers 2A03 Emulator

MSU-1 Audio music is supported.

460623.overview: The Legend of Zelda: Secrets of the Past is an hack made by superskuj. It’s a small/medium sized new quest, featuring all new dungeons, story and a new over-world with a relatively low difficulty, though there are multiple puzzles that will challenge your mind.

464425.overview: As Christmas approaches and Hanukkah swings by, the royalty of Hyrule is focused on throwing the biggest, winteriest bash of a gala it can. Unfortunately for you, Link has been roped into all of this by Zelda’s silver tongue. Assigned to do about 90% of the work, Link has been given a list of daily duties to keep him occupied while the royal family lounges around and laughs at him.

464724.overview: The Legend of Zelda: Allhallows Eve is a romhack of A Link to the Past which consists of new Halloween-themed Overworlds, Dungeons, Sprites, Music, and plenty of ASM surprises to see!

468521.overview: A romhack for Link to the Past with an edited overworld and new dungeons.

468538.overview:
Zelda’s wish has had a different outcome than expected, leading to a world not so different from her original…

This hack was made to provide a new adventure in Hyrule. As such, much of the world will have a similar feel to the original while providing new challenges, a different route, and possibly a new trick.

This hack has moderate modifications to the overworld, offering a new look to familiar spaces. Some text has been modified to match this different world. All dungeons were modified, leading to new routes, different big chest items, new puzzles, and increased difficulty. Reflecting the increased difficulty, all that remains of your uncle is a pile of clothes and his sword. Bomb jumping is not required. Save states are not required to complete this journey. Good knowledge of the base game will be helpful.

469488.overview:
The story takes place in the beautiful lands of Hylia, created by the Deities of Hylia; Saria, Darunia, and Ruto. After Hylia’s inception, two relics known as the Master Sword and the Tetraforce were left behind. The Tetraforce was an extraordinary treasure which was capable of granting any wish possible. As the world's population grew, this power became property of the Royal Family, where it was kept away from the rest of the world. Because of the unfathomable power the Tetraforce was rumored to have, many desired for this power. And soon, an evil being named Ganon emerged from an alternate world to grab the power of the Tetraforce himself.

In his attack, he shattered a part of the Tetraforce and it was downgraded to what we know now as the Triforce. The shards of the shattered Tetraforce also became the Pendant of Courage, Power and Wisdom, which were taken into hiding along with the Triforce by the Royal Family. Not long after that, Ganon reigned over the Royal Family and continued pursuing his search for the Triforce. As everything was becoming much more hopeless during Ganon’s reign, a Chosen Hero equipped with the legendary Master Sword and the Triforce emerged from the darkness to put an end to his ruling.

The Hero was successful in defeating Ganon, and he was soon sealed away by the King’s trusted Mages. Following Ganon's sealage, Hylia returned to the peaceful lands it once was. Soon after, the Chosen Hero mysteriously disappeared and let the Master Sword sleep in the Deep Woods. From there, all was looking well for the future of Hylia. But one day, Ganon escaped his seal because of a Rogue Mage who originally helped in sealing him. Ganon plotted his revenge ever since he was defeated, so when he was removed from his seal he put his plan into action. He first took over the Royal Family’s Soldiers, which caused havoc around the lands of Hylia, that were formerly protected by them.

As this is all happening, Zelda who is the daughter of the Royal Family and a friend are in the Forest Catacombs. Sensing that there was something wrong with the world of Hylia, they prayed to the Deities of Hylia. During their prayers, the Soldiers attacked and kidnapped Zelda and her friend and put Zelda into the Forest Catacomb’s Prison. Without any way to escape, she calls to her childhood friend Link, who is sleeping during this stormy and chaotic night. Hearing her calls, Link wakes up and the story begins...

471378.overview: A hack dedicated to the Legends of all the games in the Mario series.

471386.overview:
So the inspiration for this is that there are LOTS of shell hacks.
BUT, there aren't any resources on how to learn to shell jump.
(Other than banging your head against shell hacks that don't teach the mechanics of what's going on.)

Going forward,
It's assumed that you know the basic mechanics of Vanilla Super Mario World.
This isn't meant to be an exhaustive guide to every Kaizo or Shell technique in SMW.
It won't be covering basic techniques like Re-grabs, Fast Falling, Slow Falling, Etc.
Which are all covered in Learn 2 Kaizo, Kaizo Kindergarten, and 2Kaizo2Learn, to name a few.
(Honestly, if you haven't played those yet, you really should.)

What it will be covering are Shell Jumps, Shell Techniques and Shell Glitches. Some of which can be pretty difficult!
So, as one of my favorite you-tubers would say; "Sit down, grab a nice warm cup of Yorkshire Tea Gold and get comfortable!"
